page.layout: One page of a table (Annorum table), no columns of text. Running head centred at top with the page number at the top right. Below the head, the column headings in two lines. Then 38 table rows in six columns, with dash leaders into the Feriae column. No margins with text, no footer.

main_text.l: Anni ante | Aureus | Anni Olym- | An. Vrb. | Literæ | Nabona- | Feriæ.
ord.Iul. | numerus | lymp. | conditæ | domin. | sari. [?]

page.notes: Printed table, no headings. Header "Nabona-" continues as "sari." on the second line; that word is doubtful, marked [?]. The "♭" before 148 and the "*" before 152 are printed signs in the Feriae-adjacent column, copied as ♭ and *. Dash leaders run from the Nabonassar column into the Feriae column; they are not text and are written as em-dashes. Row 9 (551) and row 28 (532) show "29—I" and "28—I" in the Aureus column, copied as printed. "Ian." is printed for January. The scan is slightly faded at the right edge of the Feriae column; the numbers there read clearly.
